ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity pixels (white) concentrated in the central lobes, framed by 30% low-intensity pixels (black) at the peripheral margins and within focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe displays a contiguous high-intensity white field with a 10-20 pixel wide low-intensity black border at the trailing edge; interior contains isolated low-intensity circular clusters. Left lobe shows complex, high-frequency mottling of black and white pixels near the leading edge and water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude serrations with approximately 12 primary peaks; peak depths vary from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local mean edge line. Left lobe edge is occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe outer margin follows a sharp convex curve (parabolic fit) transitioning into a linear but highly serrated trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Right lobe contains roughly 15-20 distinct, low-intensity circular ring clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) distributed non-uniformly across the white ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of two discrete, dark linear pixel strings on the lower third of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and potential tissue loss on the right trailing edge; dense distribution of circular parasitic scars (rosettes) across the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-to-light transition zone on the visible left lobe segment, indicating a more heavily pigmented (black-dominant) pattern compared to the right lobe.
